mechanism_narrative: A persistent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 8.0%) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 8.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust demand and supply chain strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both conditions hold, or the interaction's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%), the central bank's accommodative stance reduces risk-free rates, compressing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates economic distress that reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances (regardless of UNRATE level), or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing market (HOUST > 630.0) signals strong consumer confidence and construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 630.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) indicates robust economic conditions that support equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both conditions hold, or the interaction's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 95.0) signals strong manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in a supply expansion regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
